scope: standalone M451 exact K1 fused PWP-plus-correction adapter; memories, scheduler, persistent accumulator, full-population replay, resource-normalized performance, power, energy, system speedup, and DATE headline are excluded
verified: M451 original exact-SHA VCS run inner manifest and outer seal both verify; its 363 accepted legal requests, six protocol attacks, SVA covers, and zero-mismatch receipt are intact.
M452 reused only the frozen M451 DUT and independently replaced the testbench, scoreboard, assertions, filelist, run contract, and exact-SHA runner.
Exhaustively checked all 1,048,576 signed12 PWP x signed8 correction pairs for add and subtract: 2,097,152 wide signed arithmetic pairs with zero mismatch.
Exhaustively checked all 65,536 signed8 narrow-PWP x signed8 correction pairs for add and subtract: 131,072 narrow signed arithmetic pairs with zero mismatch.
The full accepted interface range is [-2176,2175]; signed13 is sufficient, and no saturation, rounding, or source drop was observed.
Independent VCS retired 23,259 of 23,260 accepted requests; the sole difference is one explicitly injected buffered-output reload quarantine followed by reset.

Independent protocol hammer covered 13 malformed/reload conditions, a 13-cycle stall, 23,257 simultaneous pop-push cycles, and 23,257 consecutive II=1 pairs with zero metadata mismatch, unknown output, or fail-closed leak.
All independent SVA assertions passed; plain, fused-add, fused-subtract, narrow, wide, pop-push, II=1, 12-cycle stall, and sticky-fault covers each matched at least once.
M449's independently reconstructed opportunity numbers remain 517,041,352 M430 cycles and 430,154,216 M447 K1-fused cycles, exactly 1.2019906646689706x.

The adapter emits update_delta only. It does not contain or overwrite old_psum, so M426 is not revived; correctness still requires the future integration to accumulate every emitted delta into persistent old_psum.

resource_fairness.new_memory_ports_zero: architectural assertion, not proven by this memory-free adapter
resource_fairness.concurrent_existing_ports: plausible only if the separately required PWP cache and correction SRAM have independent read ports, address/control paths, and nonshared interconnect in the integrated design
resource_fairness.address_data_correlation: unproven because the adapter sees correction data and tag/tile/output-block but no explicit residual source address

findings.title: Zero new memory ports is not an RTL result
findings.detail: M451 contains no memory macro or address generator.  Its 160-byte PWP and 96-byte correction inputs prove that the datapath can consume two payloads atomically, but not that the upstream PWP cache and correction SRAM can be read concurrently without bank, address-generator, or interconnect conflicts.

findings.title: Correction descriptor-to-address correlation is outside the interface
findings.detail: The adapter checks tag, tile, and output block but receives no explicit correction source address or residual descriptor identity.  Full integration must prove that source address, polarity, PWP center, row tag, tile, and block remain aligned; directed data injection cannot establish this scheduler property.

findings.title: The 1.2019906647x point is still opportunity-only
findings.detail: The new 96-lane signed pre-adder, 256 instantaneous payload bytes, possible added pipeline stage, unchanged-II but possibly changed latency/Fmax, routing, and memory switching have not been synthesized or power-priced.  Standalone VCS correctness does not admit the M447 trace ratio as RTL-measured, resource-normalized, or system speedup.

findings.title: The frozen M451 contract contains a small ratio transcription error
findings.detail: It records 1.2019932175709652x, while 517,041,352 / 430,154,216 equals 1.2019906646689706x.  The M451 receipt and M452 contract use the correct value; future tables must use the exact quotient.

old_psum_judgment.required_next_proof: Formally prove an integrated accumulator executes old_psum plus every accepted update_delta and never treats the first fused result as a replacement seed.

required_synopsys_scope: Synthesize M451 and frozen M433 under the same 3.0 ns constraints and libraries; report incremental area, FF, logic depth, setup, and hold.
Run RTL-to-M451-mapped-netlist Formality with all 96 signed13 lanes and fail-closed state included.
Run slow-corner setup and fast-corner hold PT; do not infer unchanged Fmax from VCS II=1.
Do not include SRAM, interconnect, power, cycle admission, or system claims in those standalone logic results.
